text:
ana-security: Alert - anomalous signing observed from internal SSH CA (ca-ssh-01). ~70 certs in ~10m; treat as suspected CA compromise and follow the emergency runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ssh-ca-incident
sec-bot: :rotating_light: Detector ca-sign-rate fired (evt=ca-2468004321). Baseline ~1/min, observed ~7/min. IDS and audit logs flagged.
lena-sre: Oncall. I'm pausing the signing endpoint now and opening a 30-45m maintenance window. Expect internal SSH interruptions for a short window; use jump-emergency-1 for critical access.
mike-eng: Quick scope: which fleets consume these certs? I have bastion, deploy-runners, infra-hosts, kube-ssh-proxy, ci-workers on my list. Confirm if others.
prateek-devex: I'll prepare an automated revoke+reissue play (canary -> 25% -> full). Need serial list and revocation token from vault. Draft will be in internal repo and linked to the ticket.
nana-security: (edit) ana-security: containment checklist: 1) disable signing; 2) export issued serials; 3) publish temporary CRL to s3://redwood-ssh-crl/incident-2468 and set client CRL poll to 60s; 4) create new HSM key (label ca-rot-2468), update CA pub key in gitops, support short dual-sign overlap if required; 5) revoke leaf certs and reissue short-ttl certs.
lena-sre: Commands to collect evidence and stop service: `systemctl stop ssh-ca.service || pkill -f ssh-ca; journalctl -u ssh-ca --since "-30m" | grep "issued cert" > /tmp/ca_issued.log; grep -o "serial=[0-9a-fA-F]\+" /var/log/ssh-ca/audit.log | sed 's/serial=//' | sort -u > /tmp/issued_serials.txt`
mike-eng: Pausing pipelines that require new certs and notifying product/infra channels.
sec-bot: Policy reminder: SEC-KEY-ROT-2 requires legal & exec notification if compromise confirmed. Open ticket TKT-INC-2468-SSHCA and update status there.
legal: Please add me to the ticket; we'll triage customer notification if keys impact external workloads.
prateek-devex: Playbook link added to ticket. Will request approval for full fleet run after canary. ETA 15-20m.
lena-sre: Live checklist in ticket: [x] stop signing service, [x] export serials, [x] publish temp CRL, [ ] create new HSM key, [ ] push CA metadata, [ ] revoke leaf certs, [ ] reissue short-ttl certs, [ ] validate CI/hosts, [ ] exec/legal notify if required.
mike-eng: Assigning owners: @lena-sre ops lead, @prateek-devex automation, @ana-security sec lead. Keep incident comms in the ticket channel only; do not post raw serials or sensitive artifacts publicly.
nana-security: If we find this was an automation token misuse vs HSM theft we'll still rotate metadata and revoke certificates as a precaution. Postmortem and exec summary to follow after containment. :lock:
